title: Ensemble Toolchain Config
description: Schema for both the project-level (.ensemble/toolchain.yaml) and user-level ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ensemble/toolchain.yaml) toolchain adapter-selection files (TRD-2026-8d825f54 TRD-003, PRD REQ-009). Each of the 14 toolchain categories may optionally select an adapter by name; a config file need not set every category.
